description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/killing_me), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10707034), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000061576), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4419005058), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/10445), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63499129)

Mina, a fan of a ruining idol group, and Dearly, who is not interested in idols at all.  
Despite the opposite tendency, the two are only friends in the world and best friends.

However, Mina, who was on the signing event, fell into a coma due to an unfortunate accident.  
I resent the Mangdol group center 'Dodo' that my friend liked the most...

Meanwhile, Doui, who is on the verge of disbanding his group, tries to prevent the disbandment of the group somehow, but it is not enough.  
An unexplained supernatural phenomenon occurs in three people in such a crisis!

Will the three be able to stand up with a adversity?
